name: 81416 · Delta, CO
findings: ZIP 81416 (Delta) has 71 nonprofit organizations. 27 of them (38%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 19 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (35% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 81416 (Delta) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 81416 (Delta) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.7 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 17 organizations here; 39% of all organizations here have no identified type.
